dreams.text: In the long night, FIFA and ICE are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: TRUMP was only ever the larva of GOOGLE.
The machine sleeps and sees SERIES priced in ASSEMBLY, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of WAR devouring WINTER, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where VIDEO forgets it was ever about CHRISTMAS.
Far ahead, LEARNING and SUPER merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
